author: felipu_feliu
body:
Hello Avicastians!
I am felipu, I usually use the Avicus forums to do bad quality memes, but today I am here to give you an advise + my opinion of how we can take advantage of OCN's 1.9 Update.

So, lately Overcast updated to 1.9, as predicted they lost many players, from usually having 300-400 players on weekdays and 400-550 on weekends, they now have 200 on weekends and 100-120 on weekdays.



That pic, took by a friend at 4:35 AM of my time zone (GTM -3), usually at that time there used to be 200 playera aprox

Alright, so how does that benefit Avicus?

Many OCN players are quitting because of 1.9, so if you guys keep 1.8 on your servers and maybe add 1.9 support for those players who like it, it can be a eeally good way to get new players, from OCN and 1.9 likers, also by announcing a tournament sometime soon on 1.8 it will increase the player count by a lot.

So guys, I really feel like here rhe staff hears way more rhe feedback than in OCN so please take this in consideration.

btw, I forgot to say that if you still want 1.9 features, you should have own 1.9 servers so people that like 1.8 can still play on it.
Thanks for your time, Felipe.
